title: Story premise EDU016: The Compass Delivery Route
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (everyday science). Hook: Will the needle point the same way over here? Takeaway/theme: Magnetic-field direction varies with position around a magnet.
description: A courier needs to orient a compass beside a magnet, but expects its needle to point directly at the nearest end from every position. Moving the compass around a reviewed field diagram reveals the changing direction.
